prompts.name: 01-liste-separateurs
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity mobile web screenshot, 1024x1792 pixels, portrait, flat screen edge-to-edge without device frame or presentation background. Application Coliclic outgoing requests list /sent-bookings. Polished MINIMAL COMPACT realistic French mobile interface, Poppins typography.
CRITICAL: SIX COMPLETE compact booking rows must ALL be visible simultaneously in this single screen, comfortably legible. Each row about 76-86 logical px high on a 430x752 logical viewport; page header under 150 logical px. Never inflate one booking to fill screen. No giant whitespace. No detail view.
Exact brand palette: navy #023047 titles and route text, cyan #219EBC links/selected tabs, orange #FB8500 logo accent, background #FAFAFA, white #FFFFFF surfaces, border #E8E8EC, secondary gray #6B6B6B. Success #10B981, pending #F59E0B, rejected #EF4444, cancelled gray. Status text darker shades of these colors for contrast on pale tinted pills. No purple, gradients or heavy shadows.
Header consistent in all variants: small wordmark EXACT "Coliclic", "Coli" orange #FB8500 and "clic" navy #023047, simple small hamburger icon and navy circular avatar "AT". Below title "Demandes envoyées", small "6 demandes", compact cyan text link "Trouver un voyageur", NOT a large filled button. Heading sized realistically, not huge.
SAME SIX DATA ROWS, in exact order, no additions, omissions or duplicates:
1. route "Nantes → Abidjan"; subtitle "Poisson · 3 kg"; green status "Acceptée".
2. route "Paris → Dakar"; subtitle "Vêtements · 5 kg"; amber status "En attente".
3. route "Lyon → Lomé"; subtitle "Livres · 2 kg"; green status "Acceptée".
4. route "Bordeaux → Cotonou"; subtitle "Chaussures · 4 kg"; amber status "En attente".
5. route "Marseille → Douala"; subtitle "Documents · 1 kg"; red status "Refusée".
6. route "Lille → Bamako"; subtitle "Jouets · 2 kg"; gray status "Annulée".
Each row shows only route, parcel title, weight, status and right chevron. Long route cities MUST fit, never truncated; balanced 14px equivalent route type and 12px secondary text, 10-11px status pills. All row surfaces are tappable navigation to a separate detail page, represented by right chevron. No extra per-row buttons.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: no email, references, countries, individual timestamps, message buttons, cancel actions, telephone actions, expanders, bottom sheets, map, photographs, decorative illustrations, tracking steps, payment, delivery claims. No footer navbar or marketing. Only variant 4 can show chronological group labels, without individual dates.
Visual style elegant, clean, functional information density, restrained spacing, no nested cards. Screen should resemble a usable compact list of many requests, not a dashboard or large booking detail card.
VARIANT 1: BORDERLESS SEPARATOR LIST. Pure white main list, six flat two-line rows separated only by thin pale horizontal rules. No surrounding individual cards or icons. Route first line left, small textual green/amber/red/gray status pill aligned right, secondary parcel+weight below route, right-facing chevron at far right. Comfortable compact 82 logical px rows. White header on pale page.
